entries.title: Fixed Bed Bellows View Camera

entries.title: Fixed Part-Open Six-Leaf Iris Airlock
entries.description: One newly authored complete static architectural iris-airlock-style module for the original spacebase airlock direction. A thick circular frame has a stepped front lip, deep open throat and continuous flattened ground sole. Six complete curved thick leaves overlap in front projection in separate finite depth layers, leaving a real central through-opening; each broad outer root engages the frame. A whole chamfered side housing and fixed front boss supply drive-appearance detail. All whole leaf outlines, circular frame/ground profile and side housing coordinates are new, not an enlarged camera lens, a round recolour of the older rectangular swing hatch, a changed pose of the solid split-panel bulkhead or a fan extracted from another asset. Nine closed editable meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up, front -Y and actual horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One modular asset, zero props and zero scenes. The leaves are intentionally fixed in different axial layers: no complete cyclic over-under motion, opening range, sealing contact or linkage design is claimed. No airlock chamber, corridor, host wall, occupant or previous-module compatibility. Static game-art exterior only: no pressure containment, airtightness, decompression, working motor, aperture actuation, emergency egress, human clearance, optical iris, structural load, spaceflight readiness, manufacture, engineering or mechanical safety claim.
